review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked the two definitions it introduces, `punitBicharacter` and `zmodBicharacter`, against Mathlib. Mathlib has `AddChar.zmod`, `AddChar.zmodHom` and `AddChar.toMonoidHomMulEquiv`. Mathlib has no bicharacter notion on `Multiplicative` groups, and nothing else in the Mathlib tree I searched for those names matches `punitBicharacter` or `zmodBicharacter`. `zmodBicharacter` is a named specialisation built by composing the Mathlib definitions. Its `rfl` simp lemma `zmodBicharacter_apply` connects it to `AddChar.zmod`, so it does not compete with them. `punitBicharacter := 1` is a trivial test fixture. The file's other declarations are private example theorems and instances. Its local discrete topology on `Multiplicative (ZMod 2)` is scoped to the file. I did not check whether Mathlib already provides a topology on that type, so I can't rule out a clash. I found no case for consolidation, so I abstain.
